name: Crushing Despair, Greater
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level bard 6, mesmerist 6, sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as the spell crushing despair (the modified version from this book) except as noted above and imposes the hopeless condition on the subjects.
